sources.quote: Accelerate | Long Island Home Programs Events Portfolio Board Resources Apply Contact Building the Future of Tech, Life Sciences, Clean Energy, AI, and Science-Driven Startups. Accelerate Long Island is a unique collaboration among the region’s research, academic institutions and business communities to commercialize research and create an entrepreneurial ecosystem. Apply Now for the Long Island Innovation Hot Spot Program Why Long Island? A Region Built for Innovation. Accelerate Long Island is home to world-class research, top talent, and a thriving business community. Long Island is where startups launch and grow. APPLY TODAY Start Your Hot Spot Application Relevant documents (pitch deck, executive summary, or related materials) Please leave this field empty. Submit My Application Building the Future of Tech, Life Sciences, Clean Energy, AI, and Science-Driven Startups. From university research labs to regional innovation hubs, Accelerate Long Island fuels the growth of potential startups. With 21 portfolio companies and over $100M in follow-on funding raised, we’re proving that Long Island is more than a region, it’s a launchpad for global impact.
